---
title: "Evaluation"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full

filters:
  - jlgraves-ubc/forms
form:
  action: /api/v1/quizz
  submit: Vote!
  method: POST
  fields:
    - name: preference
      type: radio
      id: preference
      label: Which scenario is the easiest for you to identify the 'best' solution.  
      values: 
        - text: Scenario A
          value: A
        - text: Scenario B
          value: B
        - text: I cannot choose 
          value: None

include-before-body:
  text: |
    <style>
      fieldset.form-group {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
      fieldset.form-group p {
        grid-column: span 2;
      }
      fieldset.form-group :last-child {
        grid-column: span 2;
      }
      div.form-group {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .quarto-layout-row {
        display: flex ;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
      }
      figcaption {
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.8em;
      }
    </style>
---

Compare the two datasets and choose the one in which it seems easiest for you to identify the 'best' solution.  

```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true
//| echo: false
//| padding: 0 
//| layout-nrow: 1

Plot.plot( 
  {
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(
       data1 ,
        { x: "x"
        , y: "y"
        , fill: "steelblue" }

      ),
      Plot.gridX( {interval: 2.5} ),
      Plot.gridY( {interval: 2.5} ),
      Plot.axisX( [-100], {tickSize: 0
                      , label: "Best" 
                      , fontWeight: "bolder"
                      , fill: "red"      
                      , anchor: yAxis ?  "top" : "bottom" 
                      , labelAnchor:  xAxis ? "right": "left"
                      , labelArrow: yAxis ? "up": "down"
                      , labelOffset: yAxis ? -10: -10
                      
      } ),
      Plot.axisY( [-100], {tickSize: 0
                      , label: "Best"
                      // , fontSize: 10 
                      , fontWeight: "bolder"
                      , fill: "blue"      
                      , anchor:  xAxis ? "right": "left"
                      , labelAnchor: yAxis ?  "top" : "bottom" 
                      , labelArrow: xAxis ?  "right":"left"
                      , labelOffset: -10
                      , lineAnchor: "top" //yAxis ? "top" : "bottom"
                      
                             
      } ),
     
    ],
    caption: "Scenario A",
    aspectRatio: 1,
    width: 400,   
    height: 400,       
    x: { label: "" 
        , axis: "bottom"
        , labelOffset: 2
        , domain: [-10, 10] },
    y: { label: ""
        , axis: "left"
        , ticks : 5
        , domain: [-10, 10] },
  }
)

Plot.plot( 
  {
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(
       data2 ,
        { x: "x"
        , y: "y"
        , fill: "steelblue" }

      ),
      Plot.gridX( {interval: 2.5} ),
      Plot.gridY( {interval: 2.5} ),
      Plot.axisX( [-100], {tickSize: 0
                      , label: "Best" 
                      , fontWeight: "bolder"
                      , fill: "red"      
                      , anchor: yAxis ?  "top" : "bottom" 
                      , labelAnchor:  xAxis ? "right": "left"
                      , labelArrow: yAxis ? "up": "down"
                      , labelOffset: yAxis ? -10: -10
                      
      } ),
      Plot.axisY( [-100], {tickSize: 0
                      , label: "Best"
                      // , fontSize: 10 
                      , fontWeight: "bolder"
                      , fill: "blue"      
                      , anchor:  xAxis ? "right": "left"
                      , labelAnchor: yAxis ?  "top" : "bottom" 
                      , labelArrow: xAxis ?  "right":"left"
                      , labelOffset: -10
                      , lineAnchor: "top" //yAxis ? "top" : "bottom"
                      
                             
      } ),
     
    ],
    caption: "Scenario B",
    aspectRatio: 1,
    width: 400,   
    height: 400,       
    x: { label: "" 
        , axis: "bottom"
        , labelOffset: 2
        , domain: [-10, 10] },
    y: { label: ""
        , axis: "left"
        , ticks : 5
        , domain: [-10, 10] },
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true
//| echo: false

user_id = window.location.href.split('/').pop();
quizz = d3.json('/api/v1/quizz/' + user_id);
configuration = quizz.configurations ; 

document.querySelector("h1.title").innerHTML = "Evaluation of the complexity in the case " + configuration.orderKey;

data1 = d3.csv( '/api/v1/data/' +configuration.shapeKeys[0])
data2 = d3.csv( '/api/v1/data/' +configuration.shapeKeys[1])

xAxis =configuration.orders[0]
yAxis =configuration.orders[1]

a = {
  const form = document.querySelector("form");
  // add hidden input with user_id
  const user_id = window.location.href.split('/').pop();
  let input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "user_id";
  input.value = user_id;
  form.appendChild(input);
  
  input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "seed";
  input.value = configuration.seed;
  form.appendChild(input);

  input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "orderKey";
  input.value = configuration.orderKey;
  form.appendChild(input);

  input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "elapsedTime";
  input.id = "elapsedTime";
  input.value = 0;
  form.appendChild(input);

  input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "screenSize";
  input.id = "screenSize";
  input.value = window.screen.width + "x" + window.screen.height;
  form.appendChild(input);
}

function* elapsedTime( startTime ) {
  let elapsedTime = 0;
  let input = document.getElementById("elapsedTime");
  while (true) {
    
    elapsedTime = new Date() - startTime;
    input = document.getElementById("elapsedTime");
    if (input) {
      input.value = elapsedTime;
    }
    yield elapsedTime;
  }

}

currentTime = elapsedTime(new Date())
```
